Name: Better Tool Upgrade
Author: aurudev
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Allows you to buy upgrade licenses from Clint to unlock free reforging for material cost only.[/color]

This mod is mostly intended for [b]Multiplayer[/b], but it works in [b]singleplayer[/b] too.

[b][size=4]Why?[/size][/b]
This mod is designed to allow players to spend gold on tool upgrades once. Whenever I play multiplayer we always struggle to decide who should upgrade tools first when we have shared wallet enabled.[b] [/b]This is a solution we've come up with to keep everyone happy.

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[size=3]1. [b]Move Gold cost to Licenses.[/b] Licenses are shared across every player! After buying a license, you can upgrade a tool for Material cost only.[/size]
[size=3]2. Vanilla-friendly in-game lore to explain why Licenses exists with [b]in-game FAQ[/b].[/size]
[size=3]3. [b]Backports[/b] previously bought upgrades.[/size]
[size=3]4. [b]Includes slider for upgrade time.[/b] Choose between default, 1 day and [b]Instant Upgrades[/b]. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][color=#D4D4D8]
1. This mod requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], so please, install that first.
2. Unzip the files into the Stardew Valley/Mods game folder.
3. Make sure the BetterToolUpgrade.dll and manifest.json files are inside `Better Tool Upgrade` folder, not in `Mods` folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

If you have any issues, read the generic [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_mods]SMAPI mod installation[/url] instructions.
Alternatively install using Nexus's Vortex launcher.[/color]

[size=4][b]Contributing[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Feel free to send me suggestions, report bugs, and provide me fixes to mistakes in localization.

This mod relies heavily on modifying game code and populating upgrades programmatically. 
It might work with mods that add new tools, but it's not guaranteed. 
[b]Might not work with other mod that modifies Clint.[/b] It might also not work after major update. If it happens, let me know.[/size][/color]

Manifest.Name: Better Tool Upgrade
Manifest.Description: Allows you to buy upgrade licenses from Clint to unlock tool upgrade recipes, letting you forge tool upgrades using materials.
